title: Thin and cheap, difficult return
text:
Thin and cheap, difficult return. I returned these the day after delivery, about Six Weeks Ago! The item was received by the company five days ago and still no refund! Not worth the trouble…
Update, it’s now been 20 days since the item was received by the seller, still NO REFUND!!!
